explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 694 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the lorazepam injection shortage on 2018-05-03 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
The label for NDC 00409-1985-30 names Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) as the manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 976095 at that plant ended 2016-06-08 and was classified OAI, 694 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2017-02-14, 443 days before the posting.
A later inspection 1064827 ended 2018-08-15 and was also classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-04-22.
The rule-identified best option is to buy from Civica, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

rejected.text: Hospira's FDA shortage entry shows limited supply available with next delivery June 2027 and estimated recovery December 2027.
rejected.reason: month 2027-06 is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-f682b6.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%lorazepam%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%lorazepam%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key
